name: description-list
title: Description list
description: Label and value pairs for a details panel, in one to three columns, optionally with dividers.
htmlExample: <bef-description-list class="w-full max-w-xl" :columns="2" bordered :items='[{"label":"Customer","value":"Northwind Traders"},{"label":"Status","value":"<bef-badge variant=\"success\" dot>Active</bef-badge>"},{"label":"Plan","value":"Business, yearly"},{"label":"Renews on","value":"14 Jan 2027"},{"label":"Billing email","value":"accounts@northwind.in"},{"label":"GSTIN","value":"29ABCDE1234F1Z5"},{"label":"Notes","value":"Wants invoices sent to two people, reminder 7 days before renewal.","wide":true}]'></bef-description-list>
